from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from scripts.poblar_ventas_detalle_producto_canonico import (
    _soft_operational_datetime_range,
)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HEADER = ROOT / 'backend/modules/comercial_v2/sync_comercial_edarsahub.py'
DETAIL = ROOT / 'backend/scripts/poblar_ventas_detalle_producto_canonico.py'
PROTECTED_OPEN = ROOT / 'backend/core/scheduler/jobs/sync_comercial_abiertas_v2_job.py'


def test_all_softrestaurant_units_use_same_0900_detail_window():
    expected = ('2026-10-18 09:00:00', '2026-10-19 09:00:00')
    for unit in ('130MID', 'CIENFUEGOS', 'ESTELAR', 'FUTURA_SR'):
        assert _soft_operational_datetime_range(
            {'unidad_codigo': unit},
            date(2026, 10, 18),
        ) == expected


def test_header_and_detail_are_engine_transversal_not_unit_special_cases():
    header = HEADER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    detail = DETAIL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    detail_range = detail.split(
        'def _soft_operational_datetime_range', 1
    )[1].split('def _extract_soft(', 1)[0]

    assert 'offset_hours = 9' in header
    assert 'DATEADD(hour, -{offset_hours}, tr.apertura)' in header
    assert 'timedelta(hours=9)' in detail_range
    assert "== 'ESTELAR'" not in detail_range
    assert "== 'CIENFUEGOS'" not in detail_range
    assert "== '130MID'" not in detail_range


def test_protected_open_sales_synchronizer_is_not_modified_by_this_fix():
    text = PROTECTED_OPEN.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'PROVISIONAL_COMANDA' in text
